class Solution:
    def minExtraChar(self, s: str, dictionary: List[str]) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        # Convert dictionary to a set for O(1) lookups
        word_set = set(dictionary)
        
        # dp[i] = minimum extra characters for suffix s[i:]
        # We want dp[0]
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        
        # Base case: dp[n] = 0 (no characters left, so 0 extra)
        
        # Fill dp from right to left
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            # Option 1: Skip character s[i], it becomes extra
            dp[i] = 1 + dp[i + 1]
            
            # Option 2: Try to match a word starting at i
            for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
                substring = s[i:j]
                if substring in word_set:
                    # If substring is in dictionary, then extra chars = dp[j]
                    dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[j])
        
        return dp[0]
